desc:
Okay, so Okū's Explosion Signs come in four sizes in *SA* – we have ~~Tall, Grand~~ Petit, Mega, Giga, and Peta. Now, Megaflares and Gigaflares are straight up Final Fantasy abilities, while Petaflare would be one level behind Exaflare, the signature variant.

And what is Zettaflare? Even higher than Exaflare, most famously used by Donald Duck. Yes, you read that right.
